items.title: Harry Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: Russell Malone, a wonderful guitar player

ctx.x: I don’t know why this particular style of music is mostly embraced by white players.

Yeah, I don’t know what that is. Some of the audience I can maybe explain for economic reasons, maybe — it’s a shame and it’s not right — but maybe the black population isn’t economically as well off as the white population and so wouldn’t be able to afford to go to those things. Although there are certain areas of the country where that’s different. I played a jazz festival in Mount Vernon and the audience was 99% black, and the most wonderful audience in the world, they were great. But I don’t know why the…
What do you think about the hype, the press that the “young lions” get? Have you ever been called a “young lion” in the press?
